problem.passage: Urban planners in the early twentieth century championed the construction of elevated highways as a solution to worsening traffic congestion, believing that separating vehicle traffic from street-level activity would modernize cities and speed commutes. Many cities built extensive elevated expressway networks through the 1950s and 1960s. Yet by the 1980s, several cities began dismantling these very structures, having found that elevated highways often depressed property values in nearby neighborhoods, cut off pedestrian access to waterfronts and public spaces, and did little to reduce overall congestion once induced demand filled the new capacity with additional cars. Some cities that replaced elevated highways with street-level boulevards or parks reported not only improved neighborhood vitality but also traffic patterns that redistributed rather than worsened, since drivers adapted by using alternate routes or transportation modes. This reversal has led contemporary planners to treat elevated highway removal as a viable strategy rather than an admission of past failure alone.

problem.question: Which choice best states the main idea of the text?
options: Elevated highways built in the mid-twentieth century were universally regarded as costly mistakes from the moment construction began.
Cities that removed elevated highways always experienced worse traffic congestion than before because drivers had nowhere else to go.
Once seen as a modernizing solution to congestion, elevated highways were later found to harm neighborhoods and traffic flow in ways that prompted some cities to remove them with positive results.
Induced demand explains why elevated highways were originally constructed to separate vehicle traffic from street-level activity.
problem.explanation: 지문은 20세기 초 고가도로가 교통 혼잡 해법이자 현대화의 상징으로 여겨져 건설되었지만, 1980년대에 이르러 인근 지역 부동산 가치 하락, 보행자 접근성 저하, 유발수요로 인한 혼잡 미해소 등의 문제가 드러나 일부 도시가 이를 철거했고, 그 결과 지역 활력이 개선되고 교통도 재분배되었다는 내용을 담고 있다. 이 전체 흐름(건설 동기 → 문제 발견 → 철거와 긍정적 결과)을 포착하는 C가 정답이다. A는 '처음부터 모두가 실수로 여겼다'는 지문에 없는 과장이며 실제로는 처음엔 긍정적으로 평가받았으므로 인과·시간 관계를 왜곡한 것이다. B는 지문에서 철거 후 교통이 '재분배'되었다고 했을 뿐 '항상 악화'되었다고 하지 않았으므로 인과 관계를 뒤바꾼 오답이다. D는 유발수요가 건설 이유라는 지문에 없는 인과관계를 지어낸 것으로, 실제로 유발수요는 고가도로가 혼잡을 해소하지 못한 이유로 언급되었을 뿐이다.
problem.explanationEn: The passage explains that elevated highways were originally built in the early twentieth century as a modernizing solution to congestion, but by the 1980s cities discovered problems—lower property values, blocked pedestrian access, and persistent congestion due to induced demand—leading some cities to remove them, which produced improved neighborhood vitality and redistributed traffic. Choice C captures this full arc (motivation → problems discovered → removal and positive outcomes). A wrongly claims highways were seen as mistakes 'from the moment construction began,' distorting the timeline since they were initially praised. B incorrectly states traffic 'always' worsened, when the text says it was redistributed, not worsened, reversing the causal relationship. D invents a causal claim that induced demand explains why highways were built, when in fact induced demand is mentioned only as the reason highways failed to reduce congestion.
problem.evidenceTarget: 지문 전체의 중심 생각: 고가도로에 대한 평가가 현대화 해법에서 해악을 끼치는 구조물로 바뀌었고, 철거가 긍정적 결과를 낳았다는 흐름
problem.evidenceSpan: Yet by the 1980s, several cities began dismantling these very structures, having found that elevated highways often depressed property values in nearby neighborhoods, cut off pedestrian access to waterfronts and public spaces, and did little to reduce overall congestion once induced demand filled the new capacity with additional cars.
problem.answerRationale: 지문은 고가도로 건설의 초기 동기, 이후 발견된 문제점들, 철거 후의 긍정적 결과라는 세 단계 전개를 담고 있으므로 이 전환 전체를 요약하는 선택지가 중심 생각이다.

difficultyReasons: 지문 전체의 시간적 흐름(초기 신뢰→후기 재평가)을 종합해야 정답을 고를 수 있음
오답 D는 induced demand의 인과관계 위치를 정확히 파악해야 배제 가능해 다소 세밀한 독해가 필요함
오답 A, B는 절대적 표현(universally, always)으로 비교적 쉽게 배제 가능해 난이도를 낮추는 요인

distractors.plausibleBecause: 고속도로가 후에 문제가 되었다는 점에서 '실수'였다는 인상과 연결된다
distractors.matches: 지문 후반부 elevated highways가 문제를 일으켰다는 내용
distractors.whyWrong: 지문은 처음에는 현대화 해결책으로 환영받았다고 명시하며, 'universally regarded as costly mistakes from the moment construction began'은 사실과 반대됨

distractors.plausibleBecause: 교통 재분배라는 표현을 왜곡해 항상 악화되었다는 식으로 과장한 것
distractors.matches: 지문의 'traffic patterns that redistributed' 부분과 관련
distractors.whyWrong: 지문은 정반대로 교통이 악화되지 않고 재분배되었다고 서술하며 'always'라는 절대적 표현도 지문과 맞지 않음

distractors.plausibleBecause: induced demand라는 용어가 지문에 등장하여 관련성이 있어 보임
distractors.matches: 지문의 'induced demand filled the new capacity' 부분
distractors.whyWrong: induced demand는 고속도로가 건설된 이유가 아니라, 고속도로 건설 후 정체가 줄어들지 않은 이유로 언급됨. 인과관계를 뒤바꾼 오답
